recipe_times_check.name: recipe_times_check
recipe_times_check.value: ("recipe"."prep_minutes" is null or "recipe"."prep_minutes" between 0 and 10080) and ("recipe"."cook_minutes" is null or "recipe"."cook_minutes" between 0 and 10080)

planned_meal_shape_check.name: planned_meal_shape_check
planned_meal_shape_check.value: ("planned_meal"."kind" = 'recipe' and "planned_meal"."recipe_id" is not null and "planned_meal"."title" is null) or ("planned_meal"."kind" = 'free' and "planned_meal"."recipe_id" is null and "planned_meal"."servings" is null and length(trim("planned_meal"."title")) > 0 and "planned_meal"."title" is not null)
